newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigeria says all set to host African trade fair.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria says all set to host African trade fair.

text.p: Nigeria has completed arrangements to host the seventh Organisation of African Unity (OAU) trade fair, the official News Agency of Nigeria reported on Tuesday.
It said Commerce Minister Rear Admiral Jubrila Ayinla inspected the fair venue in the northern city of Kaduna at the weekend and said preparations were completed.
He said 10 African heads of state and governments had said they would attend the fair due to be held from March 29 to April 6.
"With what I have seen here...I am sure that we can host the fair as scheduled," Ayinla said.
The fair is expected to feature more than 500 participants in tourism, agriculture, construction and other business exhibitions.
It was originally scheduled to take place last year in Lagos but was postponed because of inadequate facilities and moved to Kaduna.
Since then Nigeria has spent more than one billion naira ($12.5 million) to spruce up an international trade fair complex in the city.
The military administrator of Kaduna said the state was fully ready to host the fair.
"This is the first time we are hosting this fair in Nigeria," Lieutenant-Colonel Ibrahim Ali told reporters in Kaduna. "We must therefore commit ourselves totally to the success of the fair."
The fair site spans 30 hectares (75 acres) with shops and open spaces and a 1,000-seat conference centre.
